name: Ibaraki Matasaku
source:
The head of the Ibaraki family, which runs the No. 1 Coal Mine in Kannagi Village.
He has many miners under his command.
Pushy, lustful and sadistic.
He is the older brother of Sanae Ibaraki, the first victim of the mysterious disappearances incident.
